subject: Daz
fact: Daz whispered to the Ember Vanguard that the Derro are performing a summoning ritual to make the Stone Giants sprout a second head, which probably explains what happened to the Stone Giant that fought them in the Dark Lake District.
source_quote: I turn and whisper to the Ember Vanguard, "They are performing some kind of summoning ritual to make the Stone Giants sprout a second head. This probably explains what happened to the Stone Giant that fought us in the Dark Lake District."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum told Daz that they want to stop the ritual, but their spells are almost finished.
source_quote: Grygum turns to me, "I know we want to stop this ritual, but my spells are almost finished."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin growled that they need to protect the giants.
source_quote: Thorin growls, "We need to protect the giants."

subject: Hgraam
fact: It is told that Hgraam should be able to reverse whatever ill effects on the Stone Giants, but the nature or source of this ability is not explained.
source_quote: We are told that Hgraam should be able to reverse whatever ill effects on the Stone Giants.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked Daz how they would carry the giant statue, and Daz showed him it was only two feet tall.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to me and asks, "But how will we carry the giant statue? That’s massive." I look at him confused, and I show him the statue on the platform.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is impatient with the Myconid's persistent demands and has worn thin on his patience.
source_quote: My patience has worn thin. And at this time, in the monastery, the young children would have learned to be silent, I wonder if this creature can learn to be quiet.

subject: Rump-a-dump
fact: The Myconid insists Rump-a-dump is an unhappy sprout from their circle who needs to be brought back, but the reason for their unhappiness and connection to the ape-like creatures remains unresolved.
source_quote: Rump-a-dump is a sprout from my circle who is unhappy. We need to go talk to Rump-a-dump, find out what’s going on, and bring them back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is uncertain about the safety of Pelek/Derro and questions whether the ghost is a threat.
source_quote: At first, I am confused and uncertain. More to the point, are we safe with this ghost?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz explained that there is no danger from Pelek/Derro and that tying him up would make them safer, referencing the past death of a group member at Buppido's hands.
source_quote: Daz, however, explains that there is no such danger. And that they would all be safer with the ghost tied up. The last time they trusted someone, Buppido killed one of their group.

subject: JimJar
fact: JimJar bet Grygum that his knots wouldn’t hold.
source_quote: JimJar again offers one of his silly bets. He bets me that my knots won’t hold.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum collected his winnings after Pelek/Derro remained tied up overnight.
source_quote: And when we wake up, Pelek/Derro is still tied up. And I collect my winnings.

subject: Pelek/Derro
fact: Pelek/Derro muttered about not having had a good night's sleep and questioned whether death is a form of sleep.
source_quote: I haven’t had a good night's sleep in ages. Although it’s unclear I if I am sleeping … There is this whole question about whether death is a form of sleep. I suppose I will find out.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak shouted at the Derro to chant with more vigor, insisting the ritual would not work without passion and correct delivery.
source_quote: Silence, you blithering half-wits! More vigor! This city's doom, a ritual! Dig it!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir told the Ember Vanguard that the Derro were bunched up and it was time to attack.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to the Ember Vanguard, "They are bunched up; it’s time to attack."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized the Derro avoided noticing them because they were trying to avoid being seen by Narrak, like how Priestesses of Lolth made others invisible out of fear.
source_quote: I finally understand why that Derro, who should have seen us, has not noticed us. He’s trying to avoid being seen by Narrak. I’ve seen that before, when the various Priestesses of Lolth would get angry, and everyone tried hard to be invisible.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used his darkness to cover all the Derro and asked Daz who to target.
source_quote: He plans to use his darkness, and wants to know who I will target. I say the Ettin. He nods and soon all the derro are covered in his magical darkness.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak shouted, "Demogorgon’s madness flows through me! You will embrace it or break trying!" as the battle began.
source_quote: From inside it, Narrak shouts - Demogorgon’s madness flows through me! You will embrace it or *break *trying!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouted that the circle had a madness effect on those who entered it, which his monk training allowed him to resist.
source_quote: There’s some kind of effect that the circle has on those who enter it. Some kind of madness gripped my mind, but my monk training allowed me to stop it. Be careful!

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum vomited forth a wave of acid after a violent heaving.
source_quote: I look at him as he straightens and vomits forth a wave of acid.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast scorching rays — three spears of flame — toward the Ettin, feeling invigorated and empowered.
source_quote: Three spears of flame, raging hues of orange and red, appear above me. My skin prickles and sweats under their intense heat—but I am not frightened. I feel invigorated. Empowered. These are the vessels of my inner fury.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak shouted, "What’s going on here!" as the battle erupted.
source_quote: Narrak shouts, "What’s going on here!"

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak used a white feather to cast fear on Thorin, Grygum, and Zalthir, causing them to look terrified.
source_quote: He takes a white feather and points at Thorin, Grygum, and Zalthir, says the magic words, and the three members of the Ember Vanguard look terrified.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir moved the darkness over Narrak, removing the source of the fear effect and freeing the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: Zalthir has a brilliant ploy. He moves the darkness over Narrak. As the source of the Ember Vanguard’s fear is no longer visible, they are no longer affected by it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum cast a guiding bolt that struck the Ettin, which groaned and then smiled.
source_quote: A guiding bolt from Grygum strikes the Ettin, and it groans and then smiles.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin struck the Ettin with his weapon after it had been weakened.
source_quote: But Thorin has a better chance to strike the creature, and he does.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp on where he thought Narrak was.
source_quote: I could keep them there with a spell. And so I cast Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp on where I think he is.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak screamed in rage, "You cannot stop the inevitable... the curse spreads!" as he was trapped.
source_quote: Narrak screams in rage - "You cannot stop the inevitable... the curse spreads!"
